# Rock: a squashed, jittered icosphere. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.4 --location 0 0 0.2
scale 1.2 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 7
mode object
material new Stone --base-color 0.663 0.612 0.553
shade flat
export rock.glb
